newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends week mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends week mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended the week mixed on weak consumer interest, partly due to Thanksgiving celebrations in the U.S. and European traders grouping in Hamburg for an industry dinner, dealers said.
"There was hardly any input from overseas today, partly because of the Thanksgiving celebrations and the Hamburg dinner which has grouped traders from all over Europe," said a dealer.

At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted December RSS1 buyer at 317.50 cents ($1.26) a kg, down 1.50 cents from Thursday's close. December SMR 20 was unchanged at 305.50.
